title: Welcome to Paradise - Monday, 26 October 2026 Edition
summary: An insightful 13-15 minute programme exploring key global and European stories with depth and variety. From a detailed investigation into the racist attack in Trappes, France, to the escalating tensions in the West Bank, a significant European defence stance on Ukraine, major moves in AI business, and a roundup of notable developments including French student protests and Brazil's election surprise.
